ciBaselines.source: docs/research/RENDERER-BENCHMARK-CANVAS-2D.md (ARQ-115), the lowest of three measured runs on 2026-07-22 - not the average, so ordinary run-to-run variance does not itself register as a regression.
packages/editor-shell/src/selection-benchmark.test.ts (ARQ-149), real pickAt hit-testing against ~1,000 synthetic candidates, 500 trials, median of real performance.now() measurements on 2026-07-22.
ciBaselines.note: A generous 200% threshold: at 0.035ms against a 50ms absolute target, this benchmark has enormous headroom in this environment, so a tight percentage threshold would be noise, not signal - the real gate is the 50ms absolute target asserted directly in the test.
